Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the context and the redline PDF. Short answer: both approaches are fine, but based on what you described I'd recommend splitting into two focused sessions:

- 45–60min Legal redline review (GC + Redwood legal & contracts) — deep dive on language and coverage; we can turn on recording for notes only.
- 30min Procurement/demo (technical commercial team + solutions engineer) — demo of SSO/audit flows and confirmation of artifact delivery.

Why split? Legal sessions tend to generate follow-up edits that slow the agenda, and procurement typically prefers a hands-on demo without being in the weeds of clause language. Splitting reduces the risk of the demo getting cut short.

That said, if your stakeholders prefer a single consolidated meeting, we can do a 90min block with a planned break after the legal walkthrough.

Availability: Tue 2026-05-12 11:00–14:00 PT or Wed 2026-05-13 12:00–15:00 PT. Karthik and our contracts lead (Laura) are on copy to confirm.

I'll attach a short demo deck for procurement context.
